definitions.explanation: A play, film, or TV drama set in the past and based on historical events or figures. In Japan, samurai-era stories are a common subject.

examples.japanese: {歴史劇|れきしげき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{歴史劇|れきしげき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧だ。
examples.english: This historical drama is set in the Warring States period.

examples.japanese: {歴史劇|れきしげき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{史実|しじつ}→史実：12037_shijitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧もとにし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{脚色|きゃくしょく}→脚色：18162_kyakushoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Historical dramas are based on historical fact but are dramatized into a story.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧ (history) + ⟦{劇|げき}→劇：02713_geki⟧ (play, drama). Covers stage plays as well as film and television set in the past.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歴史劇|れきしげき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上演|じょうえん}→上演：11297_jouen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to stage a historical drama

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧: period drama — specifically pre-Meiji (samurai-era) Japanese settings
- ⟦{大河|たいが}→大河：12197_taiga⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧: NHK's year-long historical drama series
